source_en:
Nephilim can call upon the power of their Angelic Lineage to transform and unleash a devestating array of attacks and abilities.

Press 'LS+RS' at the same time or the 'R-key' to transform.

Attacks in your Nephilim form recharge your Angelic Grace Meter. The player drops their held Angelic Grace upon death.

Angels have unique abilities and movesets depending upon their Sigil.

New Sigils are acquired via exploration or defeating Apostate Nephilim who have betrayed the Order.

When a Nephilim has found a new Sigil they can return to the HUB's Transmitorium to have the Sigil inscribed into them.

اضغط 'LS+RS' معاً، أو مفتاح 'R'، للتحوّل.

تشحن الهجمات في هيئة النيفيليم مقياس النعمة الملائكية. ويفقد اللاعب ما يحمله منها عند الموت.

لكل ملاك قدرات وحركات فريدة بحسب ختمه.

إذا وجد النيفيليم ختماً جديداً، فبوسعه العودة إلى "ترانسميتوريوم" في المركز لينقش الختم في جسده.

source_en:
This exotic piece of divine technology inscribes Angelic Sigils into the flesh of Nephilim, allowing them to easily and readily call upon their Angelic power.

By acquiring new Sigils, the Nephilim can return to the Transmitorium to inscribe different Angels who excel in different forms of combat, traversal, and defense.

A skilled Nephilim will utilize Angels that complement their unique combat style to maximize their efficiency as a warrior on the battlefield.

source_en:
Day 12 of the Reaping Moon. Three new "physicians" admitted under the Master's seal. None spoke. None signed. 

Day 19. Locks on D Block changed without my hand on the order. The new Sister told me the lock was always so. 

Day 26. The locks were not always so. 

Day 31. Forty-one prisoners "transferred to the lower." I have keys to every door in this keep. I do not know where the lower is. 

Day 34. Heard a man calling my name through the floor of my own quarters. He named the dog I had as a boy. I do not know that man and I do not know that floor. 

Day 36. I am leaving tomorrow. I am writing this in case.

Quarterly intake, Block C - 47 souls, billed.

Block C executions - 4, standard.

Lower - n/a. 

Bread, salted meat, gruel - reduced 60%. Lower does not require.

source_en:
The time has come, Mathias. We have belayed our response long enough. The disorder and chaos that we’ve allowed to fester within the city has now justified extreme action.  

In fact, the people hunger for it. They yearn for the strength of the iron hand. 

Even the worst heresy, sometimes, is an act in service to the greater good.  And make no mistake, there is no greater good without evil.  No advancement without destruction. No immortality without death.  

The death of others, at least.

As prefect of the Doctrine, you've done your part, your Emminence. Now we will do ours.

The people have asked for the touch of the iron hand.

Now, Mathias, we will give them what they want. 

-Solomon.

PS: The Divine has Infernus to banish souls to. We have Shoreditch Prison.
ar_before:
حان الوقت يا ماثياس. أخّرنا ردّنا ما يكفي. والفوضى التي تركناها تستشري في المدينة تبرر الآن اتخاذ إجراءات قصوى. 

بل إن الناس يتعطشون إليه. إنهم يتوقون إلى قوة اليد الحديدية. 

حتى أسوأ الهرطقات، أحيانًا، تكون فعلًا في خدمة الخير الأسمى. ولا تخطئ الظن: لا خير أسمى بلا شر. ولا تقدم بدون دمار. ولا خلود بدون موت. 

موت الآخرين، على الأقل. 

بصفتك مفوض العقيدة، فقد قمت بدورك يا صاحب النيافة. الآن سنقوم بدورنا. 

لقد طلب الشعب لمسة اليد الحديدية. 

الآن يا ماثياس، سنعطيهم ما يريدون. 

-سولومون.
